notes.title: 30% off ! From June 15th to July 5th
notes.content:
Hi Guys,

We already prepared all the things that you needed.

New hero, new enemies and more discount.

Thank you for all of your patience and support, have a good one.

Cheers,
Ti Games

notes.title: Critical Update is Coming!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I hope you guys haven't waited too long. 

Ancient Amuletor will have a big update in next few days, we add the new contents(maybe a charming hero) and also include the Into The Ice DLC, it means that players just download the Ancient Amuletor and have all the contents without download DLC additionally.

Besides, we also give all the players some discount, many thanks for your patience and support.

Anyway, see ya soon~

Best Regards,
Ti Games

notes.title: Retire and Reborn
notes.content:
Dear all,

We are the developers and the publishers of Ancient Amuletor, nice to meet you.

We are happy to inform you that the Ancient Amuletor WILL BE RETIRED. Does it sounds like strange? Because we want to give you guys the new edition! The more heroes, the more contents as well as the more game mode bring you a good game experience. 

Also, the people who has purchased our game could get the new edition for free, so don't worry about it.

We will be REBORN and be back soon.

Best Regards,
Ti Games
